verdict.rationale: Orb exposes a full programmatic API for core billing operations an agent could drive—creating subscriptions (orb-docs-8), editing plans/add-ons (orb-docs-31), plan changes with proration/credit (orb-docs-16), and credit-balance alerts (orb-docs-29)—plus idempotency and structured error handling suited to automated callers (orb-docs-17, orb-docs-25, orb-docs-15). However, there is no evidence of scoped API keys, role-based permissions, or an agent-specific auth model limiting what actions a programmatic caller can perform, which is central to the story's 'scoped permissions' requirement. Missing for 10: documented scoped API key/permission system, agent-specific auth scopes, and any explicit mention of restricting programmatic access to specific billing actions.
